$comment: THE TAILORING SURFACE. Everything that differs between two tenants of ACME Workshop lives in this file — and nowhere in any component. S4's proof (a third manufacturer with zero code changes) is an edit to this file plus a realm group. Everything here is fictional.
$comment.floorCatalog: Every Floor the Building knows how to mount, with its own label, route, blurb and order. A group SELECTS from this catalog; it never re-describes a Floor. `order` is what the manifest is served in — capability Floors in packet order, Front Desk last (AW-D15).

floorCatalog.blurb: Products, specs and the device registry.

$comment.markingVocabulary: Invented. @rr/markings renders FROM this and ships no level names, compartment names or colours of its own. `colourToken` names a --rr-* CSS custom property SLOT; the ACME theme stylesheet in @rr/ui supplies the value (AW-D22).
$comment.groups: Keyed by the Keycloak group PATH exactly as the `groups` claim carries it (full paths — /ttw/nwl is not /ttw). The asymmetry below is deliberate and is S4's seed: MER has no Vigilance Floor; Northwind has ONLY Vigilance.
